title: PSG's Hakimi to face trial on rape charges
summary: Paris ⁠Saint-Germain ⁠defender Achraf Hakimi ⁠said that he will stand trial following a rape accusation made against him. The accusation stems from a February 2023 incident in which a then 24-year-old woman accused the Moroccan player of sexually assaulting her at his home outside of Paris. Hakimi has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing.
